Name_zh-TW: 庫洛莫斯.洛薩基斯——紀錄報告
Content_zh-TW:
姓名： 庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯
身份： 知名自然哲學與神祕學學者
來源：《米薩他利日報》

報導內容紀錄：
10月12日
庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯先生正式創立自然哲學與化學技術學院，並公開其畢生研究成果，供後世學者研習。他提出一門結合數學法則、精確化學工藝與神祕學的新興學科——精密煉金術。庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯主張，學術探索不應受限於既有疆界，所有知識的探索皆旨在揭示宇宙萬物的奧秘，並以此理念作為創立學院的基礎。部分學者認為，該學院的成立或許有助於化解煉金術各派系長期以來的紛爭。

10月14日
失去公開行蹤長達三個月的庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯先生，被學生發現於一處私人住所內，當時已陷入深度昏迷。據報導，其身體未見明顯傷勢或腐敗跡象。該住所內陳設著大量以純金打造的特殊家具與機械儀器，黃金之豐富，幾乎如尋常石塊般隨處可見。此一異常現象引發外界猜測，認為其研究成果或許已超越傳統的物質轉化技術。然而，其昏迷原因至今仍未明朗。

10月21日
庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯先生的異常狀況引起自然哲學、化學與神祕學界的廣泛關注。煉金術界的知名學者與大師隨後召開會議，連續七天七夜針對此事進行討論。至第八日清晨，與會者最終僅得出一項結論：洛薩基斯先生可能已接觸到某個超越凡人存在極限的未知領域。
Content_en:
Name: Kuromus Raskius
Identity: Renowned Scholar of Natural Philosophy and the Occult Arts
Source: The Misatari Daily

Recorded Reports
October 12
Mr. Kuromus Raskius officially established the Academy of Natural Philosophy and Chemical Arts, making the achievements of his life's research available for future scholars to study. He introduced a new discipline known as Precision Alchymy, which combines mathematical laws, precise chemical techniques, and occult studies. Kuromus Raskius maintained that scholarly inquiry should not be confined by established boundaries, as the pursuit of knowledge serves to uncover the mysteries of the universe. This principle formed the foundation of the Academy. Some scholars believed that its establishment might help resolve the longstanding conflicts among alchemical factions.

October 14
Mr. Kuromus Raskius, who had been absent from public view for three months, was discovered by his students in a state of deep unconsciousness at a private residence. According to reports, his body showed no visible signs of injury or decay. The residence contained numerous unusual furnishings and mechanical instruments made entirely of solid gold. Gold was reportedly so abundant that it appeared almost as commonplace as ordinary stones. This extraordinary discovery prompted speculation that his research might have advanced beyond conventional methods of material transmutation. The cause of his unconscious state, however, remained unknown.

October 21
Mr. Kuromus Raskius's unexplained condition drew widespread attention from scholars of natural philosophy, chemistry, and the occult arts. Prominent alchemists and masters subsequently convened for a meeting that lasted seven days and seven nights to discuss the matter. By dawn on the eighth day, the assembly had reached only one conclusion: Mr. Rosagis might have encountered an unknown realm beyond the limits of mortal existence.

Content_zh-TW:
研究主題： 軌跡與翡流金（由研究人員命名）
研究人員： 庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯
軌跡
研究者認為，軌跡自萬物創造之初便已存在。這或許能解釋，為何人們在尚未完全理解宇宙之前，便已能察覺某些「刻意的設計」與「不自然的規律」。
所有能透過五官感知的事物，皆由軌跡構成。
軌跡具有唯一性與可重構性。
這項發現引出了一種可能：倘若萬物皆由可重構的軌跡構成，人們是否便能重構萬物，甚至創造新的生命？
翡流金
研究者運用軌跡的可重構性，創造出一種特殊金屬，並將其命名為「翡流金」。
翡流金的本質融合了黃金的純粹性與作為智慧之源的象徵意涵，同時具有水銀作為流動介質、連結身體與心智的象徵性質。
翡流金呈現春芽般的翠綠色，能如山間溪流般流動，亦可凝固成一顆深邃而富有光澤的寶石。
翡流金能夠儲存軌跡的形態，藉此保存已提取的軌跡。
其儲存容量具有明確上限。
Content_en:
Research Subject: Traces and Verdant Aurum (designated by the researcher)
Researcher: Kuromos Rosagis
Traces
The researcher believes that Traces have existed since the beginning of creation. This may explain why certain “deliberate designs” and “unnatural patterns” could be perceived before the universe was fully understood.
Everything perceptible through the five senses is composed of Traces.
Traces possess two fundamental properties: uniqueness and reconstructibility.
This discovery raises a possibility: if all things are composed of reconstructible Traces, could everything be reconstructed—or even new life created?
Verdant Aurum
By applying the reconstructive properties of Traces, the researcher created an unusual metal and named it “Verdant Aurum.”
Its essence combines the purity of gold, symbolizing the source of wisdom, with the symbolism of mercury as a flowing medium between body and mind.
It is emerald green like a spring bud, capable of flowing like a mountain stream, yet also solidifying into a deep, lustrous gem.
Verdant Aurum can store the forms of Traces, allowing the researcher to preserve those that have been extracted.
Its storage capacity is finite and subject to a definite limit.

Content_zh-TW:
研究主題： 玻片
研究人員： 庫洛莫斯・洛薩基斯


在翡流金與絳的出現後，研究者開始探索更完善的軌跡儲存、攜帶與重構方法，並以此創造出名為「玻片」的器具，為軌跡資料的保存與移轉提供了實用的解決方案。

為區別單一道軌跡的重構與多道軌跡的融合，玻片進一步發展出更高階的形式，稱為「融合玻片」。此變體沿用相同的基本原理，但具有更為繁複華麗的外觀，並可用於執行更複雜的軌跡融合程序。

基於煉金術士的體面考量，研究者不願為了收納器具而在外套上增添更多口袋，增加收納空間的實際需求，也是促成「全一之書」誕生的原因之一。這件器具的起因雖然平凡，卻獲得了華麗的名稱，充分展現研究者獨特的美學取向。
Content_en:
Research Subject: Slide  
Researcher: Kuromos Rosagis

Following the emergence of Verdant Aurum and Rubrith, the researcher began developing more refined methods for storing, carrying, and reconstructing Traces. These efforts led to the creation of an implement known as the “Slide,” providing a practical means of preserving and transporting Trace data.

To distinguish the reconstruction of a single Trace from the fusion of multiple Traces, a more advanced form of the Slide was developed, known as the “Fusion Glass Plate.” This variant follows the same underlying principles but features a far more elaborate and ornate appearance, while also enabling more complex Trace fusion procedures.

For the sake of an alchemist’s dignity, the researcher refuses to add more pockets to his coat merely to accommodate his equipment. Nevertheless, the practical need for additional storage space to carry multiple implements was among the reasons behind the creation of the “Book of Oneness.” Though born of a humble necessity, this implement bears an extravagant name, reflecting the researcher’s distinctive aesthetic sensibilities.

Content_zh-TW:
日期： 1825年4月3日
地點： 米薩塔里大陸法洛里基基地區周邊森林

據報導，一枚隕石墜落於米薩塔里大陸法洛里基基地區周圍的森林之中。該天體的來源至今仍無法確認。墜落所引發的火勢於當夜被撲滅後，相關物體隨即被回收，並交由米薩塔里不可解釋物品收藏庫保管。

米薩塔里不可解釋物品收藏庫備受尊敬的學者與贊助者——庫羅姆斯・拉斯基烏斯先生——認為，這位來自群星之外的不速之客，將成為推動煉金術研究的新火花，引領世人踏上一條通往前所未有未知領域的探索之路。
"這將是我們翹首期盼的火種。"
Content_en:
Date: 3 April 1825
Location: The forests surrounding the Farroriki Base Area on the continent of Misatari

A meteorite was reported to have fallen in the forests surrounding the Farroriki Base Area on the continent of Misatari. The origin of this celestial object remains unidentified. Following the extinguishment of the fire caused by its descent on the same night, the object was recovered and placed under the custody of the Misatari Repository of Unexplainable Objects.

The esteemed scholar and benefactor of the Misatari Repository of Unexplainable Objects, Mr. Kuromus Raskius, believes that this uninvited visitor from beyond the stars will serve as a new catalyst for the advancement of alchemical studies, illuminating a path toward realms of knowledge never before explored.

”This will be the flame we have long awaited.”

The formula requires a Sun Coin, featuring the Sun in Splendour surrounded by exactly sixteen stars. The coin is made from Alchemical Gold with a purity of 99.9%, obtained through Seven-Stage Refinement.

Name_ja: 最終パターンのヒント
Content_zh-TW:
火焰與觸媒以等價比例，座落於中央並賦予其燃料。
觸媒之母育有四子，燃料南北端不可侵入四子領地。

太陽凝聚成平常一半的大小，於觸媒之母的邊境，
與燃料尖端交會處鎮守著。
三個尖端被火焰覆蓋，三個尖端裸露在外。
Content_en:
Let flame and catalyst be bound in equal measure,
placed at the heart, and granted its sustaining fuel.
The Mother of Catalysts beareth four offspring;
yet the fuel’s northern and southern tips shall 
not trespass upon their sacred dominion.

The Sun, condensed to half its common form,
stands sentinel at the borders of the Mother’s realm,
where its edge meets the sharpened point of the fuel.
Three of the points are veiled in flame,
while three remain uncovered, laid bare to mortal sight.
